workflow.run.said.work.queued: Waits for the driver to start quest #{{quest}}.
workflow.run.said.work.agentAnyone: Being worked on by an agent.
workflow.run.said.work.answered: You answered its question; the same session goes on at the driver's next look.
workflow.run.said.work.park: Its session asks you something, and waits for your answer.
workflow.run.said.work.held.departed: Its done departs from your words, and waits for your yes.
workflow.run.said.work.held.evidence-unr: Its done's evidence could not be read, and it waits for your yes.
workflow.run.said.work.held.evidence-mis: Its done lacks the evidence you required, and waits for your yes.
workflow.run.said.work.awaits: Waits on the answer to quest #{{quest}}, asked of another repository.
workflow.run.said.work.unclosed: Its session finished, and quest #{{quest}} stays taken: your done closes it.
workflow.run.said.work.finished: The agent finished: {{count}} quest here is done.
workflow.run.said.work.finished_other: The agent finished: {{count}} quests here are done.
workflow.run.said.opinion.none: No second opinion is asked before this work lands.
workflow.run.said.opinion.not-asked: Asked at the driver's next look.
workflow.run.said.opinion.read-again: Read again by {{agent}}: the commits made in answer.
workflow.run.said.opinion.with-session: The working session is answering its {{count}} finding.
workflow.run.said.opinion.with-session_o: The working session is answering its {{count}} findings.
workflow.run.said.opinion.disputed: {{count}} finding is disputed: a must the working session did not fix and no recheck withdrew.
workflow.run.said.opinion.disputed_other: {{count}} findings are disputed: musts the working session did not fix and no recheck withdrew.
workflow.run.said.opinion.commits-since: {{count}} commit since was not read by another agent, and one pass and one recheck are spent.
workflow.run.said.opinion.commits-since_: {{count}} commits since were not read by another agent, and one pass and one recheck are spent.
workflow.run.said.opinion.unavailable: No second opinion could be had: {{why}}. The rule requires one, so the work waits for you.
workflow.run.said.opinion.unavailableOpt: No second opinion could be had: {{why}}. The rule does not require one, so nothing waits for it.
workflow.run.said.opinion.settled: Settled: read by {{agent}}, with nothing left disputed.
workflow.run.said.opinion.settledAnyone: Settled: another agent read it, with nothing left disputed.
workflow.run.said.opinion.anyway: You went on without a settled second opinion.
workflow.run.said.opinion.myself: You looked at it yourself in place of another agent's reading.
workflow.run.said.opinion.answered: Your Accept answered the second opinion.
workflow.run.said.opinion.answeredReview: Your Reviewed answered the second opinion.
workflow.run.said.opinion.landed: It let the work go when the work landed.
workflow.run.said.opinion.unread: Whether a second opinion holds it could not be read.
workflow.run.said.opinion.unreadWhy: Whether a second opinion holds it could not be read: {{why}}
workflow.run.opinionWhy.no-reviewer: no listed reviewer of another maker is installed
workflow.run.opinionWhy.cooling: every listed reviewer of another maker is cooling
workflow.run.opinionWhy.signed-out: no listed reviewer of another maker has an account signed in
workflow.run.opinionWhy.not-independent: no listed reviewer is another maker's agent
workflow.run.opinionWhy.ended: its reviewer ended without saying one
workflow.run.opinionWhy.out-of-time: its reviewer ran out of its minutes before it said one
workflow.run.opinionWhy.other: no listed reviewer of another maker could read it
workflow.run.opinionTwin: Go on anyway is on the session's own page, beside its second opinion, and at a terminal: `daoris-driver opinion show {{session}}` lists what is unsettled, and `daoris-driver opinion anyway {{session}} "…"` goes on without it.
workflow.run.said.look.not-shown: Waits for your look in `{{environment}}`: nothing shows it there yet.
workflow.run.said.look.being-set-up: Being set up in `{{environment}}` by its set-up step, quest #{{quest}}.
workflow.run.said.look.shownAt: Waits for your look in `{{environment}}`: shown at `{{commit}}`.
workflow.run.said.look.not-yet: You said not yet: the set-up step's session is answering your words.
workflow.run.said.look.not-held: What you reviewed does not hold the newest commits: it waits to be shown again.
workflow.run.said.look.skip: Skipped for this work, by you.
workflow.run.said.look.offChain: Not asked for this work: its chain's choice turns the review off.
workflow.run.said.look.offAsk: Not asked for this work: its ask's choice turns the review off.
workflow.run.said.look.unread: Whether it waits for your look could not be read.
workflow.run.said.look.unreadWhy: Whether it waits for your look could not be read: {{why}}
workflow.run.said.landing.accept: Waits for you to accept it.
workflow.run.said.landing.automatic: Lands automatically at the driver's next look.
workflow.run.said.landing.already: Its work reached the line another way.
workflow.run.said.landing.nothing: Nothing to land: its work made no commits.
workflow.run.said.landing.gone: Its tree was discarded before it landed.
workflow.run.said.landing.elsewhere: It ran on another machine, which keeps its landing.
workflow.run.said.pull-request.merge.ope: Open: waits for you to merge it on the platform.
workflow.run.said.pull-request.merge.unk: Waits for you to merge it on the platform; `{{plugin}}` last answered no state for it.
workflow.run.said.pull-request.merge.unr: Opened by `{{plugin}}`: waits for you to merge it on the platform.
workflow.run.said.pull-request.not-pushe: `{{plugin}}` did not push the branch, so no pull request opened.
workflow.run.said.pull-request.no-branch: Not opened: the work landed into its line.
workflow.run.said.pull-request.nothing: Not opened: there was nothing to land.
workflow.run.try.exists: the branch it would make already stands
workflow.run.try.completed: its branch's pull request was merged, so bring the repository up to date and accept it
workflow.run.added.chain: A look added for this work by its chain's choice.
workflow.run.added.ask: A look added for this work by its ask's choice.
workflow.run.added.set-up-step: A look added for this work: a set-up step shows it.
workflow.run.added.other: A look added for this work.
workflow.run.short.opinion.waiting-on-yo: a second opinion waits for you
workflow.run.short.look.working: being set up for your look
workflow.run.short.landing.waiting-on-yo: the agent finished; waits for you to accept it
workflow.run.short.landing.not-known: landed on another machine, or not
workflow.run.head: {{repository}} · Current workflow, version {{version}}
workflow.run.none: Nothing runs here yet: no quest of this work is published.
workflow.run.viewNamed: Open where this work stands in its workflow
